correctness.rationale: Coupling the two conditional trees by changing only P_j leaves the eventual descendant set of j unchanged and gives T^(0)-T^(1)=S_{j,n}D(Q_j)>0 almost surely. Future subtree growth has mean n/j and is independent of Q_j; averaging the standard depth mean H_{q-1} over q=2,...,j-1 gives the conditional mean gap and Bernoulli covariance. Harmonic telescoping gives the global covariance. Independent root-attachment indicators give Var(R_n), and the classical L2 path-length limit gives the correlation asymptotic.

evidence: Dobrow--Fill provide the path-length limit and variance coefficient used as prior input.
General increasing-tree theory is broader in model class but no inspected mixed theorem dominates the claim.
